title: What would you like to practice?
intro: Play, ask for help when you need it, and try again.
errorsBody: Return to positions from your games and practice a better decision.
playBody: Practice defense, attacks and plans from a position or a full game.
closedBody: Play closed positions and prepare a pawn break. General exercises, not yet a personal diagnosis.
yourTurn: Your turn. Play directly on the board.
hintBody: Before moving, look for a piece you would leave undefended and what the opponent could capture or threaten.
showIdea: Show the idea on the board
error: Could not check the move. You can try again.
demonstration: This is the reference move. Try again to practice it.
source: Position from one of your games
plans: Attacks and plans in closed positions
closedFrench: Closed center: prepare a pawn break
general: These are general exercises. They have not yet been identified as a personal weakness.
ownGoal: Play from a decision in your games. The opponent will respond to your moves.
planGoal: Find a plan: improve your pieces and prepare a pawn break. The opponent plays legal engine verified replies; it does not yet assess your plan as a coach.
fullGoal: Play a full game. The engine does not guarantee a particular structure or attack will appear.
illegal: That move is illegal. Choose another square.
suggestion: Consider {{move}}. This is an engine suggestion, not the only valid move.
